blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court wrapped up Day 28 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial on Tuesday with presiding officer Senator-judge Francis Escudero announcing that Wednesday’s session would be devoted to oral arguments on the conviction-vote threshold, with no witness taking the stand. Each party will be given 15 minutes to argue, after which senator-judges may ask questions before voting on a motion or appeal-cum-motion for reconsideration filed by Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo.
